89 days or up to the next regular interview, whichever is earlier

content_sections.heading: Department-wise Vacancies
content_sections.text: The notice lists one vacancy in total, in the Department of Neurology. The vacancies are provisional and subject to variation, and the Executive Director, AIIMS Bibinagar reserves the right to vary the vacancies, including reserved vacancies, as per Government of India rules, circulars and requirements. Reservation will be as per Government of India policy. If SC candidates are not available for the post of SR, the post shall be filled for 89 days on contract basis from available candidates irrespective of the category.

content_sections.heading: Qualification and Experience
content_sections.text: To be eligible, the candidate must have passed the qualifying examination as on the cut-off date, and the result must have been declared on or before that date. The cut-off date for determining the maximum age limit, essential qualification and experience, and payment of fee is 15.11.2026. Candidates should check the official notification for the discipline-specific eligibility of the post. The upper age limit is 45 years, as on the last date of submission of application. The notice prints no minimum age. The notice says relaxation in age is as per Government of India norms, with the maximum permissible relaxation as shown above. No age relaxation is available to SC/ST/OBC candidates applying for unreserved vacancies.

rows.qualification: A postgraduate medical degree viz., MD/DNB in Medicine or Degree of DM/DNB in Neurology from an NMC recognized university / Institute or equivalent qualification thereto.

rows.category: Persons with Bench-mark Disabilities (PwBD), SC/ST category

content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms
content_sections.text: The appointee is entitled to remuneration as per pay-scale. The notice does not name HRA separately; it states NPA and "other usual Allowances, as applicable". No travelling or other allowances are paid to the candidate for joining the post. The appointee shall reside in the residential accommodation provided by the Institute during the tenure, subject to availability. Tenure: 89 days or up to the next regular interview, whichever is earlier. The appointment gives no right to claim permanent absorption or continued contractual appointment, which may be renewed or terminated as the Institute decides after evaluating performance. The post is full time, and private practice of any kind is prohibited. Leave entitlement is as per the Central Residency Scheme and Institute policy. The appointee has to work in shifts and can be posted at any place or Centre attached to the Institute at the discretion of the MS/Dean/Executive Director. No extra allowance is admissible for such assignment. Senior Residents may be assigned to one or more departments and will need to work in emergency on rotation as needed. The appointee is not entitled to Provident Fund, Pension, Gratuity, Seniority, Promotion or other benefits available to regularly appointed Government servants. Either side may end the appointment at any time by giving one month's notice or paying one month's salary, without assigning any reason. A candidate who joins and leaves, resigns or is terminated before the tenure ends may do so with one month's prior notice, or by depositing pay and allowance in lieu for the shortfall. Earlier engagement as Senior Resident is counted along with this engagement against the prescribed period for SR ship. After selection, candidates are given 15 days to join at AIIMS Bibinagar; the Competent Authority may extend this in exceptional situations with reasonable justification.

faq.question: Q1. How many Senior Resident (Non-Academic) vacancies are there at AIIMS Bibinagar?
faq.answer: The notice lists 1 vacancy, in the Department of Neurology, shown under the SC category. The vacancies are provisional and subject to variation.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for the AIIMS Bibinagar Senior Resident post?
faq.answer: The last date for submission of applications is 15-11-2026 up to 5:00 PM. Applications submitted after the due date are summarily rejected.

faq.question: Q3. What is the qualification for the AIIMS Bibinagar Senior Resident Neurology post?
faq.answer: A postgraduate medical degree viz., MD/DNB in Medicine or Degree of DM/DNB in Neurology from an NMC recognized university / Institute or equivalent qualification thereto.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for the AIIMS Bibinagar Senior Resident post?
faq.answer: The upper age limit is 45 years, as on the last date of submission of application. SC/ST candidates get 5 years' relaxation, and PwBD candidates in the SC/ST category get 15 years.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary of the AIIMS Bibinagar Senior Resident (Non-Academic)?
faq.answer: Pay Level 11 of the 7th CPC Pay Matrix, with entry pay of Rs.67700/- plus NPA and other usual allowances, as applicable.

faq.question: Q6. Are HRA or other allowances paid on top of the pay?
faq.answer: The notice states the entry pay of Rs.67700/- is plus NPA and other usual allowances, as applicable. It does not name HRA separately. No travelling or other allowances are paid for joining.

faq.question: Q7. What is the application fee?
faq.answer: UR/OBC/EWS candidates pay Rs.1770 (including 18% GST) plus transaction charges. SC/ST/PwBD/Women candidates pay no application fee, and a fee once paid is not refunded.

faq.question: Q8. How do I apply for the AIIMS Bibinagar Senior Resident post?
faq.answer: Submit the online application form (Google form) available at www.aiimsbibinagar.edu.in by 15-11-2026, 5:00 PM. Bring the originals, one set of photocopies and the Annexure-I form to the interview.

faq.question: Q9. How will candidates be selected?
faq.answer: Selection is on the basis of the interview on 17.11.2026, with Document Verification reporting at 8.30 AM and the interview from 10.30 AM onwards. The selected list will be uploaded on https://aiimsbibinagar.edu.in.

faq.question: Q10. Is the AIIMS Bibinagar Senior Resident job permanent?
faq.answer: No. The engagement is for 89 days or up to the next regular interview, whichever is earlier, and gives no right to permanent absorption. It may be renewed or terminated as the Institute decides.
